letter:
Subject: Appeal against Denial D04 – Incomplete or Missing Documentation (Claim ID: ebf05489-d5e7-4482-afc8-fd99f22805af)

Claim Details:  
Patient Name: Revathi Bose (Patient ID: dd9563c2-5618-4890-a664-1a814b719ae7)  
Date of Service: 06‑04‑2026 (Emergency – Fracture of forearm, closed reduction)  
Plan: Suraksha Silver Individual Health Plan (Plan Code: SGH‑SILVER)  
Total Claim Amount: INR 85,873.41  

Grounds for Appeal: All mandatory documents enumerated in the Suraksha Silver policy – claim form, discharge summary, itemised final bill, payment receipts, investigation reports and the treating doctor’s prescription – were submitted with the claim as required [suraksha_silver_policy#18]. No written request for additional documentation was received, contrary to the insurer’s procedural requirement that a request must be made in writing before a claim can be rejected for incomplete documentation [claims_procedure_and_grievance#4].

Clinical Necessity: The treating orthopaedic surgeon will attach detailed clinical notes confirming that the closed reduction of the forearm fracture was medically necessary to restore limb function and prevent complications, in line with the requirement to provide the treating doctor’s prescription as part of the mandatory documentation [suraksha_silver_policy#18].

Reference to Denial Standards: The insurer’s denial standards expressly prohibit rejection of a claim for incomplete documentation unless a specific written request for the missing items has been issued and the insured has failed to respond within 15 days. Since no such request was issued, the denial does not comply with the documented standards [claims_procedure_and_grievance#4].

Specific Request: In view of the above, we respectfully request that the claim be re‑processed using the documentation already submitted and that the approved reimbursement amount of INR 85,873.41 be paid without further delay, as stipulated in the reimbursement provisions of the plan [claims_procedure_and_grievance#3][claims_procedure_and_grievance#4].

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Insurance Desk (on behalf of the treating provider)

### C1.2 Reimbursement

citations.section: Claims Procedure, Denial Standards and Grievance Redressal > C2. Documentation > C2.1 Requests for Further Documents
citations.quote:
## C2. Documentation  
### C2.1 Requests for Further Documents
If documents are incomplete, the insurer must request the specific missing documents in writing. It may not reject a claim for incomplete documentation unless it has first made such a request and the insured has failed to respond within 15 days. A claim must not be rejected for documentation that was in fact submitted with the claim.
